newsitem.title: USA: Pilgrim's Pride markets new type of egg.
newsitem.headline: Pilgrim's Pride markets new type of egg.

text.p: Pilgrim's Pride Corp said Thursday it will introduce a new type of egg in the Southern California and Las Vegas market.

The eggs --EggsPlus-- are naturally enriched eggs containing essential fatty acids, or polyunsaturated "good" fats, the company said. EggsPlus contain the same amount of fat and cholesterol as ordinary eggs.
Pilgrim's said many health-and-fitness enthusiasts are not eating enough essential fatty acids. It plans national distribution by next year.

The poultry company reported a net profit of $4.95 million, or $0.18 per share in the quarter ended March 29, compared with a net loss of $3.34 million, or $0.12 per share including a $0.10 charge, the year before. Its stock traded at 11-5/8 Thursday afternoon, up 1/4.
